dialogs.about: 달마다 들어오는 연금을 보며 할아버지와 살림 이야기를 해요

lines.en: Good morning. Our pension came yesterday.
That's good news. Is it enough this month?
Yes. Our income is not big, but it is enough.
Did you write the budget for this month?
Yes, I wrote all of it last night.
What is our biggest expense now?
The health insurance and the house tax.
Can we afford a small trip in autumn?
lines.ko: 가을에 짧은 여행을 갈 수 있을까요?

lines.en: Yes. I will save a little every week.
Thank you for taking care of everything.

dialogs.about: 연금 안내 창구에서 안내원에게 연금과 보험을 물어요

lines.en: Hello. I have a question about my pension.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 연금에 대해 여쭤볼 게 있어요.

lines.en: Of course, Ma'am. Please sit down here.
Thank you. Did my money come last month?
Yes. It came on the same day last month.
Good. Why is this fee on my invoice?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 청구서에 이 수수료는 왜 있어요?

lines.en: It is a small bank fee, Ma'am.
I see. Can I afford the new insurance?
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 새 보험을 감당할 수 있을까요?

lines.en: Yes. Your income is enough for it.
That's good news. Will the tax change?
No. Your tax will stay the same.
